thread:
Lina (DevEx): FYI support just flagged that the quotas dashboard shows big spikes to the "global" route for a handful of customers starting 03:22 UTC. suspected after the go-client 0.9.0 batching change rolled out.
Omar (Go SDK): oof. we shipped a batching optimization that multiplexes multiple logical requests over one HTTP stream. we tried to be conservative with headers, but I might have collapsed per-call metadata in the multiplex envelope.
Priya (Eng-Platform): that matches what our ingest logs show: batch-level metadata present but no per-item route tags, so attribution falls back to tenant/global bucket. quota ledger treats those as untagged -> global.
Jason (Console): consequence: dashboards and per-route quota charts underreport actual route usage and instead show a large "ungrouped" line. also alerts triggered for a couple of orgs hitting unexpected quota limits.
Tessa (Product): are customers actually throttled incorrectly or just seeing confusing UI? we need impact summary before we message customers.
Lina (DevEx): initial triage: 3 customers saw temporary throttling because their route-specific buckets hit limits; platform enforced global fallback quota which is tighter in their config. One customer escalated to SEs.
Omar (Go SDK): fix options: 1) include per-item route headers in the multiplex envelope (adds size and complexity), 2) include a compact route-index header plus a route-table blob on the batch (platform resolves), 3) revert batching for affected customers via client flag.
Priya (Eng-Platform): platform options: a) accept batch-route-table header and expand into per-request route tags during ingest, b) treat batched requests as best-effort and route to global bucket (current broken behavior), c) reject batched requests missing per-item route tags with 4xx to force client change.
Jason (Console): UX asks: we need a temporary dashboard aggregation that splits batched traffic by inferred route-table if available, and a quick alert that surfaces tenants sending untagged batched traffic. also show a note in the quota panel: "some data from Go SDK 0.9.0 may be aggregated".
Tessa (Product): recommended path: prioritize customer-facing correctness. propose short-term platform support for a compact route-table header so we don't break quotas, and ask Omar to ship a 0.9.1 with the compact header encoder.
Omar (Go SDK): I can do compact route-table encoding: proto-ish list of route ids + indices. example header: `Rdr-Batch-Routes: r1,r2,r3` and per-item header `Rdr-Route-Idx: 0|1|2|0`. or better: a single `Rdr-Batch-Map: 0,1,2` where order maps to items. will prototype.
Priya (Eng-Platform): we'll add support to expand `Rdr-Batch-Routes` to per-request route tags in ingest pipeline. canary this to 5% of nodes behind a flag. also emit telemetry metric `batch_route_mapping_missing` when we see batches without route mapping.
Lina (DevEx): timeline? customers want quick fix. SEs need steps to triage.
Omar (Go SDK): aim to push 0.9.1 in 6 hours with fallback that preserves single-request behavior when multiplexing disabled. will add debug log `rdr.batch.map=true/false` to help correlate.
Jason (Console): I'll add a temporary aggregate tile in the quota dashboard that splits by `Rdr-Batch-Routes` values; should be quick if platform emits expanded tags. also add a filter to surface "affected by batching" traffic.
Tessa (Product): communications: prepare an FAQ blurb + guidance for customers that can opt to disable batching in the meantime. we should proactively reach out to the 3 impacted accounts.
Deploy-Bot: infra: ingest-expand-batchroutes queued -> staging (flag: expand_batch_routes=true) at 09:48 UTC.
Priya (Eng-Platform): canary plan: staging rollout, health checks for quota ledger consistency, 5% prod nodes for 1 hr, measure `per_route_quota_hits` and `global_fallback_quota_rate`.
Lina (DevEx): Support playbook notes: 1) check logs for `rdr.batch.map` and `batch_route_mapping_missing`, 2) advise to upgrade Go SDK to 0.9.1 or set `RDR_CLIENT_BATCHING=false`, 3) escalate if quota hits persist. I'll draft and post to #support.
Omar (Go SDK): pushing branch now. proto for header: `Rdr-Batch-Routes: r1|r2|r3` and `Rdr-Batch-Idx: 0,1,2,0` where each index corresponds to items in the batch. small and parseable.
Jason (Console): quick note: when platform expands tags, we should ensure console's attribution key remains stable (route id + model). otherwise historical charts will fragment.
Priya (Eng-Platform): we'll canonicalize to `tenant:route:model` when expanding. will run migration mapping in the ingest pipeline for any new keys we generate.
Tessa (Product): keep me updated. if this looks like a wider SDK pattern we may want a cross-SDK convention doc.
Omar (Go SDK): agreed. after we land the compact header we should propose a spec and get python/ts SDKs to adopt the same compact mapping for batching.
Deploy-Bot: staging deploy succeeded at 10:12 UTC. canary rollout -> prod 5% started at 10:30 UTC. monitoring: no regressions in latency or error rates.
Lina (DevEx): thanks all. I'll notify SEs and customers listed and close out once 24h metrics look normal. re-open if surprises. :white_check_mark:
